title: A Debt for the Cover
author: Hazel Yarrow
blurb: Jonah Crane, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
